title: pepinia armata
intro: Pepinia armata, commonly known as the "snake plant" or "mother-in-law's tongue," is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. This plant is known for its air-purifying properties and has been used to promote overall well-being. The health benefits of Pepinia armata include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system.
